payload.description:
Purpose: decide whether v1 ships with task state, and on what fallback, before v1 scope is set.

Task integration is excluded from Phase 1 and Phase 2, which is correct. But docs/TASKS.md makes task state depend on a Kanbus cloud storage backend that does not exist yet, and docs/TASKS.md also says compaction eats task state if it lives only in the channel. That leaves v1 with no recorded answer for whether task state ships at all.

Definition of Done:
- A decision is recorded: v1 ships a thin local Task item, or task state is deferred to v2 with the compaction risk accepted in writing.
- The decision does not depend on Kanbus internals (table sharing or EFS) in v1.
- docs/TASKS.md and the v1 scope list reflect the decision.

Not included: building the thin Task item, Kanbus product integration (later phase).
payload.title: Decide the v1 task-tracking approach
